node.subject: english
node.title: 宾语从句: 引导词 that
node.summary: 会用 that 引导的宾语从句
node.content_req: 在第三学段 (5~6 年级)教学情境中,会用 that 引导的宾语从句。
key_points: 会用 that 引导的宾语从句
在第三学段 (5~6 年级)教学情境中
能模仿结构用 think、know、hope 等动词写出含 that 的宾语从句,且去掉 that 后句意不变
node.academic_req: 能在句子中识别 that 引导的宾语从句,说明 that 在口语中常可省略但书面语中保留更规范,并尝试用 think、hope、know 等动词写出含 that 的宾语从句。
node.assessment_prompt: 看到「I know that he is a doctor」这句话,{{name}}能不能认出 that 后面那整句「he is a doctor」是 know 这个动词的宾语?\n如果把 that 去掉变成「I know he is a doctor」,意思变了没有?让{{name}}自己再写一句类似结构的句子,比如用 think 或 hope 开头,检查 that 放回去后句意是否通顺。\n{{name}}能举个例子吗?
node.title_pinyin: bin yu cong ju :  yin dao ci  that
node.description: 想象孩子在说「I think that he is happy」和「I think he is happy」时,中间那个 that 到底要不要写? 这条规则告诉孩子: that 像一根小绳子,把后面那
node.real_examples: 人教版 PEP 六年级英语下册 Unit 1 'How tall are you?' Part B Read and write: 课文出现 'Zhang Peng says that his cousin is taller than h
node.common_mistakes: 学生常漏写 that,写成 'He thinks he is right.' 缺 that;把 that 跟 who/which 乱用,写出 'The boy that is running is my brother.' (定语从句和宾语
node.teaching_activity: 用课本配套句型卡 8 张 (He says / I think / She told me / We know / My mother believes / I hope / He says / They said),
node.teaching_voice: 我们来看,that 像一根小绳子,把宾语从句拴在 think、know 这些动词后面。想象放学路上你跟妈妈说'I think that he is kind'或'I think he is kind',意思完全一样,加不加 that 都行。记住,用 think、know、hope 写出带 that 的句子,再去掉 that,意思不变就说明写对啦。

exercises.question: Which of the following sentences uses the object clause with 'that' correctly?
exercises.explanation: A 正确:that 引导宾语从句,主语 he 后接 is 符合语法。B 语序错误,C 主谓不一致,D that 位置应在句首。
options: A. I think that he is a good student.
B. I think that is he a good student.
C. I think that he are a good student.
D. I think he that is a good student.

exercises.question: Fill in the blanks to complete the sentence: I know ____ he is honest. We all hope ____ our team can win the game.
exercises.explanation: 两个空都填 that。that 引导宾语从句,接在 know 和 hope 后,且去掉 that 后句意不变,所以 that 在此可省略但写出更规范。

exercises.question: 请用 that 引导的宾语从句,写出两个句子,分别使用 think 和 hope 作为主句动词。
exercises.answer: I think that math is interesting. / I hope that we can have a picnic this weekend.
exercises.explanation: 1. 必须使用 think 或 hope 作为主句谓语动词。2. that 需紧跟在动词后引导宾语从句。3. 从句语序为陈述句语序,主谓需一致,句意完整。
